_research_note_pass2: Second-pass structural/engineering research. Corporate note: Miami-Dade NOA filings show the legal entity behind these vinyl/molded fence NOAs has historically been 'CertainTeed LLC' / 'CertainTeed Corporation' (Buffalo, NY) before rebranding to Barrette Outdoor Living, Inc. (545 Tilton Rd / 231 Ship Canal Pkwy, Egg Harbor City NJ / Buffalo NY) -- consistent with the existing 'certainteed-bufftech' manuals folder already in this repo. All four Miami-Dade NOA PDFs found are scanned/image-based (no embedded text layer); data below was read directly off the drawing sheets via OCR-by-eye (page images), not pdftotext.

engineering_letters.finding: No standalone, publicly downloadable 'engineering letter' or generic 50-state PE wind-load certification PDF was found on barretteoutdoorliving.com, bufftech.com, or catalystfence.com for the vinyl/molded fence lines. Barrette's own CSI 3-part spec sections for its OTHER product lines (Avalon Aluminum Railing, Privacy Railing, Select Series Vinyl Railing) explicitly state that PE-stamped load-calculation documentation exists but is only available on request, per-state, via Customer Service (877-265-2220) -- it is not published online. The functional equivalent of an 'engineering letter' for the vinyl/molded FENCE lines (as opposed to railing) is the set of Miami-Dade County Notice of Acceptance (NOA) packages, which ARE PE-signed-and-sealed engineering documents (see hvhz_noa_approvals below) and which the current Catalyst installation manuals explicitly direct installers to consult for wind-code compliance ('Additional products and assembly may be required to meet wind code requirements. Notice of acceptance (NOA) can be found at www.miamidade.gov/building/pc-search_app.asp' -- Vinyl Post & Rail/Ranch Rail Install Instructions, WEB REV 1.25).
